cli.help:
Neurons {version}
Live 3D view of what Claude Code reads, edits, creates and deletes in a repository.

Usage:
  neu [repo] [options]            Same as "neu start [repo]"
  neu start [repo] [options]      Starts the viewer and installs the hooks while it runs
  neu ls                          Lists the running viewers
  neu open [repo]                 Opens a repo's viewer in the browser
  neu stop [repo] [--force]       Closes a repo's viewer (its hooks are removed on exit)
  neu stop --all                  Closes every viewer
  neu install [repo] [--port N]   Installs the hooks by hand
  neu uninstall [repo]            Removes the hooks (and reverts bashEditDiffEnabled)
  neu replay [repo|file.jsonl]    Replays a recorded log
  neu doctor [repo]               Checks the environment
  neu help                        Shows this help

Options:
  --port N         Port (default {port}; when taken, the next free one is used)
  --strict-port    Fails when the port is taken instead of looking for another
  --no-open        Does not open the browser
  --no-install     start: does not install the hooks
  --no-bash-diff   start: does not turn on bashEditDiffEnabled in the user settings
  --all            stop: closes every viewer
  --force          stop: if the viewer does not close within {stopSeconds} s, kills it (SIGKILL) and removes its hooks
  --lang en|es     Language of the messages (also NEURONS_LANG; otherwise the system's)
  -h, --help       Shows this help
  -v, --version    Shows the version

[repo] is the current directory when not given. Inside a git repository its root is
used, even from a subfolder. "neu open" without a repo opens the viewer of the repo
you are in; if none runs there, it opens the only one running or lists them.
"neurons" works the same as "neu". With the viewer open, the user guide is at
<url>/help and the architecture at <url>/architecture.

Examples:
  neu                          Viewer of the repo you are in
  neu ~/projects/api           Viewer of another repo (one per repo, each on its own port)
  neu --port 8080 --no-open    Fixed port, without opening the browser
  neu ls                       Which viewers are running and at which URL
  neu open ~/projects/api      Opens that repo's viewer again
  neu stop                     Closes the viewer of the repo you are in
  neu stop --all               Closes them all
  neu replay                   Replays .neurons/events.jsonl of the current repo
  neu --lang es                Messages in Spanish
common.noViewer: No Neurons viewer is running on {repo}.
common.noHooks: There were no Neurons hooks to remove.
common.runUninstall: Run "neu uninstall" to clean them up.
common.runUninstallRepo: Run "neu uninstall {repo}" to clean them up.
common.excludeFailed: Warning: could not update .git/info/exclude ({error}). Do not add {dir}/ to git.
common.webMissing: Warning: the web UI is not built (npm run build:web).
args.badPort: Invalid port: "{value}". Use a number between 0 and 65535.
args.badLang: Invalid language: "{value}". Use en or es.
args.isFile: {path} is a file, not a folder.
args.replayHint: If it is a recorded log, replay it with: neu replay {arg}
args.dirMissing: If it is a repository, the folder {path} does not exist.
repo.notGit: Not a git repository: the tree is built by walking the folder (without node_modules, dist or build).
browser.failed: Could not open the browser ({error}). Open {url} by hand.
bashDiff.restored: bashEditDiffEnabled is back to its previous value.
bashDiff.inUse: bashEditDiffEnabled stays on: another open Neurons viewer uses it.
bashDiff.retry: It is retried by the next "neu start" or "neu uninstall"; you can also remove the key by hand.
bashDiff.enabled: bashEditDiffEnabled turned on in {path} while the viewer runs.
bashDiff.shared: Another Neurons viewer already turned on bashEditDiffEnabled: it stays on while any of them is open.
bashDiff.missing: {path} does not exist: bashEditDiffEnabled is not turned on.
bashDiff.invalid: {path} is not valid JSON: bashEditDiffEnabled is not turned on.
bashDiff.enableFailed: Could not turn on bashEditDiffEnabled ({error}): going on without it (Bash deletions are attributed by the watcher).
legacy.running:
The previous version (repo-synapse) is running on {repo} (PID {pid}). Close it before {action}.
If that process is not repo-synapse, delete {lock} and try again.
lock.tookOver: Found a stale lock (PID {pid}, no longer Neurons): taking over.
lock.live:
A Neurons viewer is already running on {repo} (PID {pid}). Close it before opening another one.
If that process is not Neurons, delete {lock} and try again.
lock.busy: Could not take the lock of {repo}: another Neurons viewer is starting on the same repo.
start.webMissing: Warning: the web UI is not built (npm run build:web). The server still receives hooks.
start.watcherFailed: Warning: could not watch the disk ({error}). Only Claude Code's events are shown, without external changes.
start.registryFailed: Warning: could not register the viewer ({error}): "neu ls", "neu open" and "neu stop" will not see it.
start.excludeFailed: Warning: could not update .git/info/exclude ({error}). Do not add .claude/settings.local.json or {dir}/ to git.
start.noInstall: The hooks were not installed (--no-install): Claude Code will not send events.
start.ctrlCHooks: Ctrl+C to quit: the hooks are removed on exit.
install.viewerRunning:
Neurons is running on {repo} (PID {pid}) and its hooks are already installed: they are left alone.
Close it before installing the hooks by hand.
install.hookErrorWarning: Until a server listens on port {port}, Claude Code will show "hook error" on every tool.
uninstall.stillRunning: Warning: Neurons is still running on this repo (PID {pid}).
uninstall.legacyRunning: Warning: the previous version (repo-synapse) is still running on this repo (PID {pid}).
replay.noLog: No log to replay: {file} does not exist.
doctor.title: Neurons {version}: checking {repo}
doctor.web.missing: The web UI is not built (npm run build:web).
doctor.docs.ok: Guide and architecture pages built in {dir} (routes /help and /architecture).
doctor.docs.missing: The guide and architecture pages are not built (npm run build:docs): /help and /architecture answer 404.
doctor.node.old: Node {version}: Node {min} or later is required.
doctor.json.invalid: The {scope} settings ({path}) are not valid JSON.
doctor.installed.running: Hooks installed on port {ports} (Neurons running, PID {pid}).
doctor.installed.orphan: There are Neurons hooks on port {ports} but the viewer is not running: Claude Code will show "hook error". Run "neu uninstall".
doctor.installed.none: The hooks are not installed (they are installed by "start").
doctor.legacyHooks.running: There are hooks of the previous version (repo-synapse) on port {ports}, and that version is running (PID {pid}).
doctor.legacyHooks.stale: There are hooks of the previous version (repo-synapse) on port {ports}: the next "neu start", "neu install" or "neu uninstall" removes them.
doctor.lock.running: Neurons is running on this repo (PID {pid}).
doctor.lock.stale: There is a stale lock (PID {pid}, no longer Neurons). The next "start" replaces it.
doctor.legacyLock: The previous version (repo-synapse) is running on this repo (PID {pid}): close it before using "neu start".
doctor.allowlist.missing: allowedHttpHookUrls in the {scope} settings does not include {url}. Add "http://127.0.0.1:*/hook?src=neurons".
doctor.allowlist.none: No allowedHttpHookUrls: HTTP hooks to 127.0.0.1 are allowed.
doctor.managedOnly.managed: allowManagedHooksOnly is on in the managed settings: the hooks in settings.local.json do not run.
doctor.managedOnly.other: allowManagedHooksOnly appears in the {scope} settings; it only has an effect in the managed ones.
doctor.disableAll: disableAllHooks is on in the {scope} settings: no hook runs.
doctor.strictPlugin: strictPluginOnlyCustomization blocks the hooks in the project settings.
doctor.proxy.ok: There is a proxy ({vars}) and NO_PROXY covers 127.0.0.1.
doctor.proxy.warn: There is a proxy ({vars}) and NO_PROXY does not cover 127.0.0.1: the hooks could go through the proxy. Add 127.0.0.1 to NO_PROXY.
doctor.bashDiff.on: bashEditDiffEnabled is on in the user settings.
doctor.bashDiff.noFile: {path} does not exist: "start" cannot turn on bashEditDiffEnabled (Bash deletions are attributed by the watcher).
doctor.bashDiff.off: bashEditDiffEnabled is off; "start" turns it on while it runs.
doctor.bashDiff.owners.one: Neurons turned on bashEditDiffEnabled; {count} open viewer uses it.
doctor.bashDiff.owners.other: Neurons turned on bashEditDiffEnabled; {count} open viewers use it.
doctor.bashDiff.pending: Reverting bashEditDiffEnabled in {path} is still pending. Run "neu uninstall" or remove the key by hand.
settings.invalidJson: {file} is not valid JSON ({error}). It was not modified.
settings.notObject: {file} does not hold a JSON object. It was not modified.
settings.hooksNotObject: The "hooks" key of the settings is not an object. It was not modified.
settings.eventNotList: hooks.{event} is not a list. It was not modified.
ls.noArgs: "neu ls" takes no arguments: it lists every viewer.
open.noViewer:
No Neurons viewer is running on {repo}.
Start it with: neu start {arg}
open.noneRunning: No viewers are running. Start one with "neu" inside the repository.
open.pick: Say which one to open: neu open <repo>
stop.allNoArgs: "neu stop --all" takes no repo: it closes every viewer.
stop.leftHooks: Neurons hooks were left in {repo}: remove them with "neu uninstall {arg}".
stop.timeout: The viewer of {where} did not close within {seconds} s.
stop.timeoutHint: Check with "neu ls" in a while, or force it with "neu stop --force {arg}" (it then removes its hooks).
stop.terminatedWin: Viewer of {where} terminated (Windows has no SIGTERM: the viewer cannot clean up, so "neu stop" does it).
stop.notViewer: PID {pid} recorded for {repo} is not a Neurons viewer: no signal was sent.
stop.error: Could not close the viewer of {where}: {error}
sessions.found.one: There is 1 Claude Code session open in this repository (PID {pids}).
sessions.found.other: There are {count} Claude Code sessions open in this repository (PID {pids}).
sessions.live.one: It picks up the hooks live, without a restart (verified with Claude Code {version}).
sessions.live.other: They pick up the hooks live, without a restart (verified with Claude Code {version}).
sessions.restart.one: If you see no events with an older version, restart it: /exit and then claude --continue.
sessions.restart.other: If you see no events with an older version, restart them: /exit and then claude --continue in each one.
sessions.unknown: Open Claude Code in this repository. A session that was already open picks up the hooks live (verified with Claude Code {version}).
sessions.none: Open Claude Code in this repository.
server.webMissing: The UI is not built. Run npm run build:web.
server.docsMissing: The page is not built. Run npm run build:docs.
